inputs.text: The T-shirt design features a minimalist tech aesthetic with clean typography and geometric shapes. The main focus is on the 'Error 404: Sleep Not Found' concept, with a monochromatic color palette and an accent of bright blue. The design consists of bold lines representing code glitches, with a sleek font displaying the error message in an eye-catching way.

Avoid overcomplicated designs that don't work well on T-shirts due to low legibility or unappealing aesthetics. Also avoid poor quality indicators such as blurriness, pixelation, or low color contrast.
